violations.title: Cooling from 135F to 41F, No More than 6 Hours
violations.observation: The following cooked time/temperature control for safety food are not being adequately cooled from 135F to 70F within two hours and to 41F within a total of six hours: OBSERVED LEMONGRASS SOUP MADE THE NIGHT PRIOR TO INSPECTION AT 45F IN THE WALK-IN COOLER.
violations.corrective_action: Time/temperature control for safety foods shall be cooled from 135F to 70F within two hours and to 41F within a total of six hours to prevent the growth of harmful bacteria. Foods that have been temperature abused are to be discarded. PIC DISCARDED OF SOUP. EHS REVIEWED PROPER COOLING PROCEDURES WITH THE PIC. PLEASE ENSURE CONTINUED CORRECTION. CHAY (Inspection Date: 07/30/2026) Page 2 of 3

violations.title: Hot Holding
violations.observation: The following food items were observed hot holding at improper temperatures using a calibrated food temperature measuring device: OBSERVED RICE AT 78F IN A RICE WARMER AND ONION SOUP AT 92F ON THE COUNTER-TOP NEXT TO THE COOK-LINE.
violations.corrective_action: Time/temperature conrol for safety food shall be held hot at a temperature of 135F or above unless the permit holder is using 'time as the public health control' as specified under 3-501.19. PIC WILL ENSURE THESE FOOD ITEMS ARE DISCARDED AFTER A TOTAL OF FOUR HOURS. IN THE FUTURE, THE ESTABLISHMENT WILL ENSURE HOT FOODS ARE HELD AT 135F OR ABOVE.

violations.title: Cold Holding
violations.observation: The following food items were observed cold holding at improper temperatures using a calibrated food temperature measuring device: OBSERVED HALF AND HALF AT 56-59F AND ALMOND/COCONUT MILK HALF AND HALF AT 55F IN THE 1-DOOR AVANTCO COOLER.
violations.corrective_action: Time/temperature control for safety food shall be held cold at a temperature of 41F or below unless the permit holder is using 'time as public health control as specified under section 3-501.19 to limit bacteria growth. PIC DISCARDED OF FOODS DURING INSPECTION AND UNDERSTANDS COLD HOLDING FOODS SHOULD BE KEPT AT 41F OR BELOW. PLEASE DO NOT USE THIS COOLER UNTIL IT CAN MAINTAIN TEMPERATURES BETWEEN 34-38F.

violations.title: In-Use Utensils Proper Storage
violations.observation: In-use utensils improperly stored between use as follows: OBSERVED 4 KNIVES STORED BETWEEN PREP TOPS/TABLES IN THE BACK KITCHEN.
violations.corrective_action: During pauses in food preparation or dispensing, food utensils shall be stored in one of the following manners: 1) in the food with their handles above the top of the food and the container, 2) in food that is not time/temperature control for safety (TCS) food with their handles above the top of the food within containers or equipment that can be closed, 3) on a clean portion of the food preparation table or cooking equipment only if the in-use utensil and the food contact surface of the food preparation table or cooking equipment are cleaned and sanitized, 4) in running water of sufficient velocity to flush particulates to the drain, 5) in a clean, protected location if the utensils are used only with a food that is NOT TCS food, or 6) in a container of water if the water is maintained at a temperature of at least 135F and the container is cleaned frequently. PIC REMOVED THE KNIVES AND EHS DISCUSSED PROPER UTENSIL STORAGE WITH THE PIC.

out_items.name: Food and non-food contact surfaces cleanable, properly designed, constructed, and used

violations.title: Equipment, Maintain in Good Repair/Condition
violations.observation: The following refrigeration unit is not operating properly and is unable to maintain cold food at or below 41F: OBSERVED THE 1-DOOR AVANTCO UPRIGHT COOLER AT 58F.
violations.corrective_action: Repair/adjust the unit so it is able to maintain foods at or below 41F. Do not use the unit to store time/temperature control for safety foods while it is not operating properly. PIC DISCARDED OF FOOD ITEMS IN THIS COOLER DURING INSPECTION AND UNDERSTANDS ALL COLD HOLDING UNITS SHOULD BE KEPT BETWEEN 34-38F. PLEASE ENSURE THIS COOLER IS NOT USED FOR TCS FOODS UNTIL IT IS REPAIRED/ADJUSTED.

violations.title: Food-Contact Surfaces, Durable Materials
violations.observation: The food-contact surfaces of the following equipment and/or utensils are not resistant to corrosion: OBSERVED GROCERY BAGS USED TO DIRECTLY STORE SOME FOOD ITEMS THROUGHOUT THE BACK KITCHEN.
violations.corrective_action: Materials that are used in the construction of utensils and food-contact surfaces of equipment may not allow the migration of deleterious substances or impart colors, odors, or tastes to food and under normal use conditions shall be resistant to pitting, chipping, crazing, scratching, scoring, distortion, and decomposition. PIC UNDERSTANDS GROCERY BAGS SHOULD NOT BE USED TO STORE FOOD ITEMS DIRECTLY. PLEASE DISCONTINUE STORING FOODS IN THIS MANNER AS SOON AS POSSIBLE.

out_items.name: Proper eating, tasting, drinking, or tobacco use

violations.title: Eating, Drinking, or Using Tobacco
violations.observation: A food employee was observed eating, smoking, or drinking in areas where they may contaminate food, clean equipment, utensils or other items needing protection. OBSERVED EMPLOYEE DRINKING COFFE FROM AN OPEN CUP.
violations.corrective_action: Food employees may only eat, drink, or use tobacco in a designated area like a dining room or office area. Employees shall not eat or drink in the kitchen areas, warewashing areas, or storage areas where items may become contaminated. EHS EDUCATED EMPLOYEE AND EMPLOYEE CHANGED CUPS TO ONE WITH A LID.

out_items.name: Adequate handwashing sinks properly supplied and accessible

violations.title: Handwashing Cleanser, Availability
violations.observation: Observed that hand soap was not provided at each handwashing sink.
violations.corrective_action: Provide hand soap at each hand sink to allow employees to properly wash their hands.

violations.title: Access to Handwashing Sink
violations.observation: The handwashing facility located by the cook line is blocked by a prep table, preventing access by employees for easy handwashing.
violations.corrective_action: A hand washing sink shall be maintained so that it is accessible at all times for employee use.

violations.title: Paper Towels Provided
violations.observation: Observed that paper towels were not provided at each handwashing sink.
violations.corrective_action: Provide paper towels at each hand sink to allow employees to properly dry their hands after handwashing.

violations.title: Cooling from 135F to 70F, No More than 2 Hours
violations.observation: The following cooked time/temperature control for safety food(s) are not being adequately cooled from 135F to 70F within two hours: tofu 75F (3.5 hrs) in the 3 dr prep top, soy beef 78F (4 hrs), soy chicken 72F (4 hrs) on the counter.
violations.corrective_action: Time/temperature control for safety foods shall be cooled from 135F to 70F within two hours to prevent the growth of harmful bacteria. Foods that have been temperature abused are to be discarded. PIC DISCARDED FOOD.

violations.title: Eggs Stored at 45F or less
violations.observation: Observed an ambient air temperature above 45F in the following refrigeration unit holding raw shells eggs: observed raw shell eggs on the counter for 4+ hours
violations.corrective_action: Shell eggs that have not been treated to destroy Salmonella shall be stored in refrigerated equipment that maintains an ambient temperature of 45F or less. PIC DISCARDED EGGS.

out_items.name: Adequate handwashing sinks properly supplied and accessible

violations.title: Access to Handwashing Sink
violations.observation: The handwashing facility located near the dishwasher was blocked by a bowl in the hand sink preventing access by employees for easy handwashing.
violations.corrective_action: A hand washing sink shall be maintained so that it is accessible at all times for employee use. PIC UNDERSTANDS THAT THERE CAN NEVER BE ANYTHING BLOCKING THE HAND SINK SO EMPLOYEES CAN ALWAYS WASH THEIR HANDS TO PREVENT POTENTIAL CROSS CONTAMINATION AND THE POTENTIAL SPREAD OF A FOOD BORNE ILLNESS. PIC REMOVED THE BOWL FROM THE HAND WASHING SINK.

violations.title: Handwashing Sink, Water Temp
violations.observation: The handwashing sink located near the dish washer was not reaching the minimum temperature requirement of 100F.
violations.corrective_action: A handwashing sink shall be equipped to provide water at a temperature of at least 100F through a mixing valve or combination faucet. PIC UNDERSTANDS THAT WATER AT EACH HAND SINK MUST REACH AT LEAST 100F OR HIGHER FOR PROPER HAND WASHING. PIC IS GOING TO REACH OUT TO PLUMBER AND HAVE THE ISSUE LOOKED AT.

violations.title: In-Use Utensils Proper Storage
violations.observation: Dispensing and/or in-use utensils improperly stored between use as follows: a knife being actively used for food prep was being improperly stored between two prep top units.
violations.corrective_action: During pauses in food preparation or dispensing, food utensils shall be stored in one of the following manners: 1) in the food with their handles above the top of the food and the container, 2) in food that is not time/temperature control for safety (TCS) food with their handles above the top of the food within containers or equipment that can be closed, 3) on a clean portion of the food preparation table or cooking equipment only if the in-use utensil and the food contact surface of the food preparation table or cooking equipment are cleaned and sanitized, 4) in running water of sufficient velocity to flush particulates to the drain, 5) in a clean, protected location if the utensils are used only with a food that is NOT TCS food, or 6) in a container of water if the water is maintained at a temperature of at least 135F and the container is cleaned frequently. PIC NOW UNDERSTANDS THAT NO UTENSILS CAN BE STORED IN AN AREA THAT IS UNABLE TO BE WASHED, RINSED AND SANITIZED. PIC REMOVED THE KNIFE FROM IN BETWEEN THE PREP TOP UNITS AND MOVED IT TO BE PROPERLY CLEANED.
